text: Please find a copy of the Questionnaire that we discussed. It is the
complete questionnaire, of which only the ETS part was used by all
collaborating studies. Several centers used the complete questionnaire
though we do not know which ones, nor what use will be made of the data.
Also included is a study published in 1989 on Dietary Intake and Passive
Smoking which included some very helpful findings.
Any thoughts from you on these matters would be most welcome.
